# Foundry chat test application

This fixture is adapted from
[`nevenc/spring-ai-quickstart-azure-openai`](https://github.com/nevenc/spring-ai-quickstart-azure-openai)
at commit `d79823c804bcf14228791d99eb3d02129939cba0`.

Changes are limited to Java 21, runtime-only Azure OpenAI configuration, naming,
and minor source formatting. The upstream MIT license is preserved in `LICENSE`.

Live tests must copy this fixture to a temporary directory before running
`azd spring init`.
